module_summary: HDLC bit-stream Moore FSM counting consecutive ones to flag bit-stuff discard, frame flag, and 7+ ones error.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Ones-run tracking states S0-S6 plus SDISC/SFLAG/SERR; decodes disc, flag, err.

anchors.name: disc
anchors.why: Stuffed zero after five ones must be discarded; decoded from SDISC.

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: Frame boundary 01111110 detected; decoded from SFLAG.

anchors.name: err
anchors.why: Seven or more consecutive ones error; decoded from SERR.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Serial HDLC bit stream driving every state transition.

groups.name: hdlc_fsm
groups.description: Sequence-recognizer state register with Moore output decode.
